$comment: Accounts the ai-usage daemon tracks (pkgs/ai-usage/main.ts), drawn by the herdr-app ai-usage mod and `ai-usage` in a terminal.
Edits apply on the daemon's next pass (or `ai-usage refresh`); no rebuild.

Common keys: id, provider (claude | anthropic-api | hermes | codex), title, subtitle, price ($/mo, subscriptions), url, color, interval (minutes), hosts (short hostnames; omit = everywhere), disabled.
claude: configDir, a Claude Code config dir or a list of candidates (first with a login wins).

anthropic-api: exact month-to-date cost from the Admin API. adminKey ({op: 'op://…'} | {file: '…'} | {env: 'NAME'}) holding an Admin key (sk-ant-admin01-…, Console → Settings → Admin keys) or a personal key (sk-ant-usr-…) not scoped to a workspace; budget ($/mo the bar fills toward); workspaceId (one workspace only; null = Default). Unavailable to Console *individual* orgs (every report endpoint answers 403 'Missing permissions'): set up an organization first (Console → Settings → Organization).
hermes: Hermes' own estimate of its Anthropic spend (list prices, from its session log); no key needed. stateDb (default /var/lib/hermes/.hermes/state.db); budget.
codex: codexHome (default $CODEX_HOME or ~/.codex); localCost adds a local session API-equivalent estimate at standard rates, not billed spending. Codex itself renews expired logins when installed.

accounts.$comment: Shares the OAuth usage quota with ~/.claude-work/claude-usage-work.ts (15 min) and herdr-usage-watcher.ts, hence the slow interval.
